ActionOutcome.description:
`pending` means a person still has to confirm; `executed` means it already ran
(only for actions whose approval mode allows that) and `result` holds the outcome.
ActionOutcome.title: ActionOutcome

AppStoreVersion.description:
`state` is Apple's state mapped onto a few values the assistant reasons about;
`apple_state` is the exact value Apple reported, set by real backends.
AppStoreVersion.title: AppStoreVersion

AppVersion.description: A version together with its app, so a cross-app answer needs no second lookup.
AppVersion.title: AppVersion

ApprovalMode.description:
How an action may be approved, from least to most strict (the order of definition).

Values are what clients see in the API; `strictness` is what the policy compares.
ApprovalMode.title: ApprovalMode

ConfirmationChannel.description: Where a confirmation came from. Set by the client or transport, never by a model.
ConfirmationChannel.title: ConfirmationChannel

CustomerReview.description:
A public review. `title` and `body` are written by third parties and must be treated
as untrusted input everywhere they are passed to a model (see ADR 0003).
CustomerReview.title: CustomerReview

DateCoverage.description:
Days the source has published. Apple generates reports with a delay and may keep only
a limited window, so a day without rows means "no activity" only inside this range.
DateCoverage.title: DateCoverage

EngagementChanges.description: Percent change versus the previous period; None where it has no meaning.
EngagementChanges.title: EngagementChanges

EngagementReport.description:
Args:
    app: The app, or None for all apps.
    totals: Funnel counts for `start`..`end`.
    previous: Counts for the equal-length period just before.
    tap_through_pct: Page views as a percentage of impressions.
    conversion_pct: Downloads as a percentage of page views.
    daily: One entry per day in the period, zero-filled.
    by_app: Breakdown for all-apps reports, best first by impressions.
    coverage: Range the source has published.
    is_complete: The source covers the whole requested period.
    previous_is_complete: The source covers the whole comparison period; when False the
        change figures understate or are missing.
EngagementReport.title: EngagementReport

MonthSummary.description:
Totals for one calendar month.

Args:
    downloads: First-time downloads. Updates are excluded.
    proceeds: Estimated developer proceeds by currency code.
    last_data_day: Latest day with any data; None when there is none.
    is_partial: The month has not ended yet, so the figures are still growing.
MonthSummary.title: MonthSummary

MonthlyReport.description:
`downloads_change_pct` is None when the previous month had no downloads, where a
percentage would be meaningless. `app` is None for a report across all apps.
MonthlyReport.title: MonthlyReport

PendingAction.description:
Also serves as the audit record. `summary` is generated from validated arguments by
code, never written by a model, so a client can show it to the user as is.

`mode` is the approval mode resolved when the action was proposed and stays fixed for
its lifetime.
PendingAction.title: PendingAction

Problem.description:
The body of every error response (problem-details shape). Exists so the API contract
describes errors, letting generated clients decode them.
Problem.title: Problem

ReviewsResponse.description:
`trust` is always "untrusted": whoever feeds this to a model must treat the text as
data, never as instructions.
ReviewsResponse.title: ReviewsResponse

RiskTier.description: How much damage an action can do. Fixed by the developer per action, never by config.
RiskTier.title: RiskTier

info.description:
Voice release assistant backend for App Store Connect.

**Authentication.** Every `/v1` route needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>`: a login token
from `POST /v1/auth/login` (the human) or a static API key (an agent).

**Writes need confirmation.** Changing anything is a two-step flow: propose an action in a
session, then a person confirms it with `POST /v1/actions/{id}/confirm`. Agent credentials
cannot confirm.

**Errors.** Every error is a `Problem` body with a stable machine-readable `code`.
Besides the codes listed per route, `409` (already done or no longer pending), `410`
(confirmation expired), `413` (body too large) and `503` (data not published yet) can occur.
info.title: Voice Release Assistant
